compute_surface_distances: compute surface distances from ground truth and predicted 2D or 3D binary masks with voxel spacing
compute_average_surface_distance: compute average surface distance between ground truth and predicted surfaces using surfel-weighted distances
compute_robust_hausdorff: compute robust Hausdorff distance as a percentile of surface-to-surface distances weighted by surfel areas
compute_surface_dice_at_tolerance: compute surface DICE coefficient at a specified tolerance in mm for two binary masks
compute_surface_overlap_at_tolerance: compute surface overlap fraction at a specified tolerance in mm for ground truth and predicted surfaces
